# Local Industry Twin acceptance packages

Place the governed, final ZIPs here using these local-only names:

- `UKEU-001-final.zip`
- `TMS-001-final.zip`
- `DIST-001-final.zip`

The ZIPs are intentionally ignored: they may be licensed, sensitive, or large. Run
`python tools/inspect_industry_twin_packages.py` to produce deterministic JSON
inspection evidence. Synthetic ZIPs generated in
`tests/test_flora_package_contracts.py` are the committed regression fixtures.
